jobs.occupation: Technology Transfer & Partnership Manager – Applied Geodata & Research Solutions (Full-Time / m/f/d) (Master of Business Administration)
jobs.description:

Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent / Dual Master Track available) 

Target Group: Business Development Managers, Technology Transfer Specialists, Marketing & Sales Talents, Master’s Graduates, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Holders 

About Project Iris 

Project Iris is an applied research initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, land registry intelligence, sustainable infrastructure mapping, and open-source resilience modeling. 

To ensure long-term independence and funding for non-profit research, Project Iris works with an established commercial transfer network (including RE-Managers GmbH). Through this framework, proprietary data algorithms, geospatial scoring models, and automation tools are licensed and deployed across real-world commercial sectors (e.g., real estate, institutional investments, infrastructure providers, and SME enterprise solutions). 

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- Research Transfer & Commercialization: Identify commercial use cases for our geospatial and resilience data models, translating scientific capabilities into clear value propositions for enterprise clients and institutional partners. 
- B2B Outreach & Pipeline Management: Lead proactive outreach campaigns targeting potential data partners, municipalities, enterprise clients, and specialized service providers using modern CRM and automation tools (e.g., Odoo ERP, automated email workflows). 
- Partner Onboarding & Account Management: Manage communication with corporate partners, coordinate pilot testing phases, and gather operational market feedback to help researchers refine underlying data models. 
- Marketing & Value Proposition Communication: Create structured presentation decks, use-case briefs, and digital campaign materials to position our data products in commercial and public markets. 
- Funding & Grant Alignment: Support the interface between commercial data licensing and applied research funding projects. 

What We Are Looking For 

- Educational Background: Degree in Business Administration, Technology Management, International Business, Marketing, Geoinformatics, Economics, or a related field. 
- Professional Competencies: 
- Strong interest in technology, spatial data, AI platforms, or digital business models. 
- Experience with or quick adoption of digital outreach tools, CRM systems (e.g., Odoo), and structured email communication. 
- High level of communication clarity, commercial acumen, and consultative relationship-building skills. 
- Mindset: Proactive, structured, and comfortable working at the intersection of non-profit research and commercial markets. 
- Eligibility: Open to local and international applicants currently in Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card, Job-Seeker Visa, EU Work Permit). 
- Languages: Excellent working proficiency in English (required); good command of German is a strong advantage for the DACH market. 

What We Offer 

- Full-Time Permanent Position: Long-term career security with direct exposure to executive management and commercial leadership. 
- Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: We support continuous academic development through fully sponsored Master Trainee and Dual Master tracks. 
- Accommodation & Onboarding Support: Concrete assistance with local housing search, official registration, and structured onboarding. 
- Visa & Relocation Assistance: Comprehensive employer backing for German Opportunity Card conversions and residence permit processes. 
- Direct Business Impact: Drive the commercial sustainability of high-impact research projects without corporate bureaucracy.

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer – Applied AI, Geodata Systems & Data Transfer (Full-Time / m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available) 

Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent) 

Target Group: Software Engineers, Data Engineers, Full-Stack Developers, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Holders, and Master’s Graduates 

About Project Iris 

Project Iris is an applied research and technology initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, cadastre intelligence, infrastructure mapping, and open-source data modeling. 

Together with our commercial transfer network (including RE-Managers GmbH), we bridge the gap between academic data science, resilience research, and practical real-world application. Complex geospatial and resilience data models are deployed into active enterprise environments, stakeholder portals, and infrastructure tools. The resulting real-world usage and performance metrics are continuously validated and fed back into our open research models. 

In this role, you turn algorithmic frameworks and spatial datasets into robust, production-ready digital architectures. 

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- Geospatial & Core Data Modeling: Develop and refine automated pipelines for spatial datasets, open-source cadastre records, and environmental scoring algorithms using Python. 
- AI-Assisted Full-Stack Integration: Transform algorithmic logic into high-performance FastAPI backends and connect them with modern React/Next.js frontends (leveraging cutting-edge tools such as v0.dev, Cursor, and Windsurf). 
- Applied Transfer & Enterprise Workflows: Implement real-world pilot applications by connecting data models to practical workflows (e.g., automated property screening, municipal portals, and ERP/Odoo interface connections for infrastructure). 
- Multi-Tenant Architecture & Cloud Deployment: Package services into robust Docker multi-container environments and deploy them on secure European/Swiss server infrastructure (Infomaniak VPS) with strict Row-Level Security (RLS) and data privacy standards. 
- Continuous Feedback Architecture: Establish data pipelines that capture operational feedback from commercial deployments to refine and advance the research models. 

What We Are Looking For 

- Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Software Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent practical industry experience. 
- Core Technical Skills: 
- Solid programming foundation in Python (FastAPI, Pandas, data handling) and/or modern Web technologies (TypeScript, React, Next.js). 
- Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL) and containerization (Docker / Docker Compose). 
- Practical experience or strong interest in AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, v0.dev, LLM APIs). 
- Mindset: Strong analytical curiosity, proactive problem-solving attitude, and a clean-code engineering approach. 
- Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates currently in Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card, Job-Seeker Visa, or EU Work Permit). 
- Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus. 

What We Offer 

- Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories into Senior Engineering or Technical Leadership roles. 
- Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: For candidates looking to combine full-time practice with further academic credentials, we offer tailored Master Trainee tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support. 
- Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding support. 
- Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and German residence/work permit applications. 
- Modern AI-First Work Environment: Work in a high-efficiency environment where repetitive boilerplate code is automated, allowing you to focus on high-value architecture, data logic, and deployment. 
- Direct Mentorship: Close collaboration with experienced technical architects and executive leadership. 

How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.de

jobs.occupation: Scientist (PostDoc) (m/f/d) (100 %) (Elektroniker/in - Geräte und Systeme)
jobs.employer_name: Leibniz-Institut für Agrartechnik und Bioökonomie e.V.
jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

As part of the HORIZON project ‘Towards scalable monitoring, reporting, verification and mitigation of non-CO2 greenhouse gas and ammonia emissions from land-based agricultural systems (MARVELA)’, we are looking, subject to funding approval, for a

Scientist (PostDoc) (m/f/d) (100 %)

for the task area 

Development and validation of IoT-based sensor systems for environmental monitoring

Within the MARVELA project, innovative, cost-effective and user-friendly measurement systems for the continuous monitoring of greenhouse gases, ammonia and relevant environmental parameters at farm level will be developed, optimized and validated. At ATB, the work focuses on the further development of modular IoT-based sensor systems, the integration of sensors, embedded electronics and communication interfaces, and their application in livestock buildings and manure-management systems. The developed systems will be tested under laboratory and practical farm conditions and validated against state-of-the-art reference measurement methods.

Your tasks

Your main responsibility will be the development, implementation and scientific validation of electronic measurement systems for agricultural emission monitoring. This includes in particular:

- Further development and optimization of modular IoT-based sensor systems for environmental and emission monitoring
- Integration of sensors, embedded electronics, data loggers, power supplies and communication interfaces into robust measurement systems
- Programming and configuration of microcontrollers, device interfaces and automated data-acquisition systems
- Planning and conducting laboratory tests, calibrations and measurement campaigns in livestock and manure-management systems
- Validation of low-cost and mid-cost sensors against state-of-the-art reference measurement instruments
- Development and implementation of quality-assurance procedures, measurement protocols and technical documentation
- Processing, quality control, statistical analysis and interpretation of measurement data
- Coordination of technical activities with project partners and preparation of scientific publications, reports and presentations

Your qualifications

- Successfully completed doctorate in electrical engineering, mechatronics, technical informatics, embedded systems, measurement and sensor technology, physical engineering or a comparable discipline
- Proven experience in scientific project management
- Proven experience in the development, integration and operation of measurement and sensor systems
- Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers and hardware-related programming
- Knowledge of common device interfaces and communication protocols, such as I²C, SPI, UART, RS-485, Modbus, Ethernet or LoRaWAN
- Experience in sensor calibration, measurement-system validation, quality assurance and systematic troubleshooting
- Strong programming and data-analysis skills, preferably in Python, R, MATLAB, C or C++
- Very good English skills, an independent and solution-oriented working style, teamwork, willingness to conduct field measurements
- Desirable: Good command of German, EU driving licence class B

We offer

- An attractive, interdisciplinary and international working environment with a highly motivated team
- An exciting position in a cutting-edge field of environmental monitoring and sensor technology
- Excellent infrastructure with state-of-the-art laboratory and measurement technology
- Access to national and international networks for your scientific development
- Training and further education opportunities
- Family-friendly working conditions to promote work-life balance
- Financial contribution to VBB company ticket or Deutschlandticket
- A workplace at the edge of a picturesque landscape, easily accessible by bike or public transport

The full-time position (40 hours/week) is initially limited to 3 years. Part-time employment is also possible if desired. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience according to TV-L up to pay grade 13. The preferred starting date is in Q1 2027.

For more information, please contact Dr.-Ing. David Janke (Tel.: +49 331-5699 513) and on the Internet at www.atb-potsdam.de (http://www.atb-potsdam.de) .

Have we sparked your interest? Then apply by 25 September 2026 with your cover letter, CV (without photo), and employment references and/or contact details of referees via our online application portal for this job posting (reference number 2026-SM-3) at https://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies (https://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies) . Applications received after the application deadline cannot be considered. We look forward to your application!

What to Expect

Tesla's retail stores are more than sales floors, they are the physical expression of our brand, our products, and our mission. As Regional Retail Program Specialist you will support the connection between EMEA retail marketing strategy and real customer experience on the ground. As part of the Central Europe Sales Operations team, you will work alongside the Customer Engagement, CX, Infradev, and local store teams to help ensure that every program, every asset, and every touchpoint tells a consistent, curated story from the moment a customer walks in the door.This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role that requires presence in market. You will travel regularly within Central Europe to support program rollouts, conduct brand standard checks, and build the kind of trusted local relationships that help EMEA strategy land.

What You’ll Do

- Support the consistent implementation of brand standards across all locations in Central Europe
- Support the implementation of retail programs in market, including new product launches, seasonal campaigns, and evergreen initiatives

- Conduct regular store standard checks across each location and report field observations, learnings, and local market dynamics to the relevant teams
- Support and inform different stakeholders on new and existing store developments, helping ensure retail standards and educational elements are integrated
- Support the piloting of new retail concepts and sales tools locally, and help facilitate best practice sharing across markets
- Build and maintain comprehensive database of brand assets and equipment for each location in Central Europe

What You’ll Bring

- 1–2 years of experience in retail marketing, operations, or a related field - ideally within a consumer brand, automotive, or tech environment
- Good understanding of in-store brand experience, consumer journey, and retail standards
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, with support from senior team members
- Highly collaborative - comfortable working across functions including marketing, operations, design, and facilities

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) bridges the gap between scientific spatial data research and practical implementation, identifying and evaluating high-value strategic sites for energy storage systems and digital infrastructure.

We provide complete end-to-end support for international candidates under the German Opportunity Card system, including official paperwork, degree validation, housing assistance, and living allowances during the trainee phase. On-site German language courses and direct involvement in high-impact energy infrastructure initiatives are part of the package.

You will translate spatial data analyses and infrastructure parameters into structured location dossiers and automated B2B lead profiles. You will support technical communications with project partners and institutional stakeholders, while capturing practical industry feedback to continuously refine our spatial queries and research algorithms. 

Candidate Profile & Qualifications: 

Applicants should possess a completed degree in Business Engineering, Spatial Economics, Real Estate, Spatial Planning, or Geoinformatics with a commercial mindset. You must have strong communication and organizational skills, an ability to interpret infrastructure maps and site metrics, and fluent English skills.

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) conducts applied research into spatial data systems, automated data extraction, and infrastructure transformation. We build scalable data pipelines to turn fragmented public records into structured spatial insights.

We fully sponsor and support your relocation journey to Germany via the Opportunity Card framework, managing visa formalities, degree assessments, and onboarding logistics. About the Research Institute: 

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) is a non-profit, applied research institute dedicated to developing cutting-edge spatial resilience data models and open-data architectures for the energy transition, critical infrastructure, and sustainable regional planning. 

What We Offer: 

We provide comprehensive administrative support for international candidates, including full assistance with the German Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte), degree recognition, and visa procedures. You will receive structured onboarding, local accommodation support, coverage of basic living expenses during training, on-site sponsored German language courses, and access to a modern data engineering tech stack centered on Python, PostGIS, Docker, and GIS platforms. 

Your Role & Key Tasks: 

In this role, you will build and maintain automated Python-based spatial data pipelines connecting to WFS services, REST APIs, and public open-data platforms. You will implement spatial overlay and inference models for energy grid matching and land-use analysis, while validating, structuring, and transforming vector geometries into our central PostgreSQL and PostGIS databases. 

Candidate Profile & Qualifications: 

We welcome applicants with a completed university degree in Geoinformatics, Computer Science, Data Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related technical discipline. You should bring practical experience or a strong learning interest in Python (GeoPandas, Shapely), SQL databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS), spatial reference systems, and automated data ingestion workflows. High motivation and fluent English skills are required. 

How to Apply: 

Please submit your CV along with a short cover letter in English. We look forward to welcoming you to the IRIS team! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)
